title: Dashboards
intro: Widgets on a grid, in sections: the floor plan zoomed to an area with the layers you pick, widgets, tiles, your own text and the other big-screen pages. Split a widget to put panes side by side. Open one full screen on a TV.
name: Name
cycleHint: Plan panes showing a whole hall without a fixed hall
canvasHint: Drag a widget by its handle, resize it by its corner (with the keyboard: arrows, Shift+arrows). Click it to set it up or split it. At most {{max}} widgets on {{cols}} columns.

edit.moveHint: Drag to move. Arrow keys move it, Shift+arrows resize it.

form.label: Pane settings
form.pickOne: Pick a pane on the left to set it up.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: Optional; plan panes name their hall and area by themselves.
form.hallHint: Empty: the first hall (or all of them in turn)
form.noBlocks: This hall has no seat blocks.
form.noZones: This hall has no zones yet. Draw one on the plan (Zone tool) and give it a label, for example VIP.
form.boxHint: Move and zoom the plan to the part this pane should show, then keep it.
form.noTiles: No tiles. Turn on a plugin with tiles under Settings > Plugins.
form.marksHint: Public: only the Overview and Safety marks, for a screen people walk past.

pane.failed: Couldn't load the plan. Trying again.
pane.noPlan: This hall has no plan yet.
pane.areaGone: The part of the hall this pane shows is gone. Edit the dashboard to pick another.
pane.tileGone: This tile is gone (plugin off or removed).
pane.noText: Write something in the pane's settings.
pane.private: Needs an account: not shown on a public screen.

section.title: Section title
section.empty: No widgets here yet: add one, or remove the section.

publicHint: Opens without signing in, for a screen in the hall. Shows the plan, switch and seat counts, the switches down and texts; other panes need an account.
